criteria.title: everyone’s 21+
criteria.body: every guest, guest of honor included. bring your id.

criteria.title: thursday to sunday
criteria.body: events happen on the days we’re open. give us a backup date too, just in case.

criteria.title: saturdays come with a band
criteria.body: there’s live music every saturday. want a saturday? say so on the form and we’ll talk it through.

criteria.title: the earlier, the better
criteria.body: dates go fast, especially around the holidays. a few weeks out gives everyone room to plan.

criteria.title: good fits
criteria.body: birthdays, work nights, showers, watch parties, small fundraisers, the after-party. if it’s a feel-good thing, it probably fits.

criteria.title: snacks, sorted
criteria.body: pizza, hot dogs, charcuterie trays and the rest of the snack menu can come out with the drinks. tell us roughly how many are eating.

steps.title: tell us about it
steps.body: fill out the form below. it takes about two minutes.

steps.title: we email you back
steps.body: we’ll talk through the date, the headcount, drinks and food.

steps.title: lock it in
steps.body: once the details are agreed, the date is yours.

form_intro: no commitment yet. this just starts the conversation.
thanks_body: we’ll email you back about your date. didn’t that feel good?
